chapters.title: Run a query and read the result
chapters.key_idea: query() returns an async iterable of typed messages; the `result` message is the contract.

chapters.title: Give the agent a custom in-process tool
chapters.key_idea: A custom tool is a Zod shape plus an async handler, served in-process by createSdkMcpServer() and addressed as mcp__<server>__<tool>.

chapters.title: Wrap it in a tiny CLI
chapters.key_idea: Inject query() and the output streams so the CLI is testable offline; the result message drives the summary line.
